generic_domain.justification: Optimization is the overarching field that encompasses both convex optimization and non-convex optimization as disjoint subdomains. Convex optimization concerns itself with problems where the feasible region is a convex set, and the objective function is convex or concave. Non-convex optimization deals with more complex problems where the feasible regions are not necessarily convex or the functions involved may have multiple local minima. Optimization techniques form the backbone of numerous algorithms in computer science, mathematics, engineering, and data science, including deep learning frameworks which rely on optimizing loss functions to train neural networks.
